input.question: How well do defenses trained against adaptive or co-evolving attackers resist adaptive indirect prompt injection?

supporting.quote: CoER reduces adaptive attack success from 41.3% to 0.2% and raises safe task completion from 39.6% to 76.2%
our defended Qwen3.6-27B achieves a 9.0% ASR against the SoTA PISmith adaptive prompt injections, compared to 94.0% for the prior SoTA, Meta-SecAlign
CODEL reduces attack success rate (ASR) by 88.5%

draft_answer: Well in the reported settings: co-evolutionary training cut adaptive attack success to 0.2%, token-level on-policy distillation reached 9.0% against an adaptive attack where the prior best had 94.0%, and another co-evolved defense cut ASR by 88.5%.
